metadata.title: LAMOST observations in the Kepler field. Analysis of the stellar parameters measured with the LASP based on the low-resolution spectra

notes: No eligible stars. Table 5 (T:p44-b0; I:p44-b0) lists objects labeled MPs, VMPs, and HVs, but the paper’s only stated HV selection is a heliocentric radial-velocity threshold, v_rad < -300 km/s, after visual inspection (T:p33-b0; T:p40-b1). This threshold is not defined or demonstrated as a Galactic-unbound criterion, nor are the stars’ velocities compared with an escape speed or otherwise stated to be presently unbound from the Milky Way. The MP/VMP labels likewise do not establish Galactic unboundedness. No star is studied as a follow-up of a previously identified Galactic unbound candidate.
